name: Uproot game SFX pack v1
policy: Use only purpose-built sounds for the mapped event.
Do not use rejected audition sounds.
Do not synthesize, layer, or substitute unrelated foley for a missing event.

shoot_arrow.usage: Normal bow shot with arrow loaded.
shoot_arrow.playback: Play once on arrow release. Keep pitch variation subtle.
shoot_arrow.author: dorkster

empty_bow_release.playback: Play when the player releases the bow without an arrow.
empty_bow_release.author: qubodup

hit_wood_board.usage: Arrow hitting wood or board-like cover.
hit_wood_board.playback: Play on arrow impact against wooden cover or board material.
hit_wood_board.author: plantmonkey

hit_sand_or_rock.playback: Play for small sand, dirt-adjacent, or stone contact impacts.
hit_sand_or_rock.author: rubberduck

hit_rock_chip.usage: Small shell or chip falling from rock.
hit_rock_chip.playback: Play for smaller rock chip feedback.
hit_rock_chip.author: rubberduck

hit_actor.usage: Carrot or soft vegetable actor hit.
hit_actor.playback: Play sparingly on non-wood actor hit. Keep it crisp and modest.
hit_actor.source: CC0 Sounds Library - break crunch impact 01
hit_actor.author: ETTiNGRiNDER

hit_hard_dirt.playback: Play for firm dirt or packed ground impacts.
hit_hard_dirt.author: cyoung510

hit_harder_dirt.playback: Play for harder packed dirt impacts.
hit_harder_dirt.author: Ali_6868

shroom_hit.usage: Arrow hitting a red or purple shroom body.
shroom_hit.playback: Play on shroom hit. Keep soft and low so it reads as an organic pop, not a hard impact.
shroom_hit.source: 40 CC0 water / splash / slime SFX - slime_12
shroom_hit.author: rubberduck

shroom_death.playback: Play once on shroom death. Slightly fuller than shroom_hit, still soft.
shroom_death.author: rubberduck

spore_break.usage: Spore broken by a dodge collision.
spore_break.playback: Play as a short pop when dodge invulnerability destroys a spore.
spore_break.author: cyoung510

dodge_roll.playback: Play once when a dodge starts. Keep quiet so it reads as body motion, not UI.
dodge_roll.author: Kenney

walk_soft_1.playback: Play with movement-state throttling only. Keep very low volume and low priority.
walk_soft_1.source: Grass Foot Step Sounds (Yo Frankie!) - left step
walk_soft_1.author: Blender Foundation / Lamoot

walk_soft_2.playback: Alternate with walk_soft_1 while moving. Keep very low volume and low priority.
walk_soft_2.source: Grass Foot Step Sounds (Yo Frankie!) - right step
walk_soft_2.author: Blender Foundation / Lamoot

player_damage_soft.usage: Bowbert taking dart or spore damage.
player_damage_soft.playback: Play on player damage. Very short and soft; avoid gun-like hard transients.
player_damage_soft.author: EZduzziteh

room_clear.usage: Combat room cleared and doors open.
room_clear.playback: Play once when the current room enters the cleared/open state.
room_clear.author: Brandon Morris

pickup.usage: Arrow pickup or small collectible pickup.
pickup.playback: Play once on pickup. Keep it light and short.
pickup.author: Vinrax

equipment_toggle.playback: Play once on equipment or quiver panel toggle.
equipment_toggle.author: Kenney

empty_bow_release_heavy.usage: Heavier no-arrow empty bow release if the primary feels too light.
empty_bow_release_heavy.author: qubodup

emptyEvents.arrow_flyby: The auditioned arrow whoosh was rejected as noisy.
